events.summary: Baseline review of Sonic Neighbours 0.1.0: exact package bytes, library.suggest descriptor, no requested network/filesystem permissions, deterministic fixture behavior, privacy source policy and local Flow-feature ranking were checked.
limitations: Similarity quality depends on the availability and accuracy of Melodex Flow analysis; unanalysed candidates are skipped by this reference algorithm.
A sonic similarity score is an explainable heuristic, not an objective statement that two tracks are musically alike.
Melodex does not broker paths/database keys to library.suggest, but extension subprocesses are not yet protected by a complete OS sandbox.
